brief:
The Global Sumud Flotilla set sail from Barcelona in early April with the stated goal of exposing what organizers described as international complicity and Israeli crimes, according to Dawn. The mission aimed to challenge Israel's blockade of Gaza and demand the opening of a humanitarian corridor. Participants in the voyage understood the risks they faced in attempting to break through the restrictions.

Saif Abu Keshek, an organizing committee member, characterized the flotilla as a challenge to Israeli impunity rather than solely a humanitarian operation. The departure from Spain represented a continuation of previous efforts by activists to confront the blockade through direct action, framing the journey as a statement against both the Israeli restrictions and what organizers viewed as complicity by the international community.
